integrity: Infinite-family classification established by a combinatorial proof with separately executable finite sanity checks. Does not claim that the previously published ordinary failed-forcing scalar is new.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only minimum-cardinality forts of KG(n,2) for n>=5; not all inclusion-minimal forts. The 2024 ordinary failed zero forcing article has not been inspected in full and may affect publication priority.
title: Four-edge ordinary and skew forts in two-subset Kneser graphs
